text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we've had repeated KV eviction spikes. Need a compact runbook with 3 triage steps, vetted commands, clear owners, and timelines.

kevin: I can own runbook edits and open a PR. Planning: verify, contain, failover. Will add exact alert queries and command snippets.

sam: I'll add root-cause notes (prefix skew -> KV size growth) and attach a small load harness for tests.

lisa: Product wants an explicit rollback and an opt-in higher eviction threshold for Dedicated. Need a template to notify customers when toggled.

akshay: oncall here  Manual fixes during peak are painful. We should expose an "approved mitigation" action in alerts so oncall can trigger a safe command with one click.

maria: Draft triage (short):
1) Verify symptom: `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (model) > 50` OR `model_kv_miss_rate > 0.2`
2) Contain: set `cache.read_only=true` for model + emergency scale if autoscale didn't spin up
3) Failover: route to quantized fallback if p95 latency > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes

kevin: Commands to include: 
```
# set cache readonly
redwoodctl models patch model-foo --set cache.read_only=true
# emergency scale
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool model-foo-pool --add-replicas 2
# shift traffic to fallback
redwoodctl traffic shift --from model-foo --to model-foo-quantized --percent 100
```
Will open PR today: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pull/999 (WIP).

maria: Add exact alert queries and a short note why long-prefix traffic grows KV usage. Also include a rollback snippet: `redwoodctl models patch model-foo --set cache.read_only=false`.

sam: Adding tests and harness to the PR. Will include a simulation of long-prefix skew and expected metrics.

akshay: I'll file an infra ticket for the mitigation button (INFRA-1477) and add permission matrix requirements.

lisa: I will write the product-notify template and where to log customer toggles.

runbook-bot: Action RB-999 created and assigned to kevin, due 1744118400.

maria: Final checklist before merge:
- kevin: draft PR + address comments (RB-999)
- sam: attach harness and test scenarios
- maria: smoke test in staging and sign off
- akshay: infra ticket and permission matrix
- lisa: product notification template + rollback wording

kevin: Will ping reviewers Friday morning. Planning a verification meeting Mon 10am PT.

maria: Please update the postmortem action tracker when tasks complete. If anything slips, escalate here. :thumbsup:
